title: ui-main: create state machine hook
description: Create a state machine hook that manages the Progressive Discover workflow state. Implements phase transitions, state persistence, and event handling for the entire discover workflow from extracting through locked phases.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL manage workflow state through all phases
THE SYSTEM SHALL persist state across browser sessions

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL validate transition and update current phase state
THE SYSTEM SHALL serialize and save current state to storage
THE SYSTEM SHALL restore previous state if available

unwanted.condition: IF invalid phase transition is requested
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow skipping phases or backward jumps
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT crash or leave state in inconsistent condition

preconditions: State machine definition must be complete
Storage adapter must be available for persistence
Phase transition validators must be defined
postconditions: State machine manages all phase transitions
invariants: State is serializable at any point

happy: Given extracting phase completes, when transition requested, then state advances to preview phase
Given state is modified, when persistence triggered, then state is saved to storage
Given stored state exists, when hook initializes, then previous state is restored
error: Given invalid transition from extracting to locked, when requested, then transition is rejected with error
Given storage unavailable, when persistence attempted, then fallback to in-memory state
Given corrupted stored state, when restoration attempted, then state resets to initial
